patterns.note: A dark, minimalist layout with generous vertical spacing between sections, emphasizing large, impactful typography and a clean, uncluttered presentation.
Section headings use extremely large, thin, uppercase sans-serif fonts, creating a dramatic and editorial feel, contrasted with smaller, more readable body text.
A high-contrast dark mode palette dominates, featuring a deep charcoal background with light grey text, occasionally accented by a subtle, muted greenish-grey.

An initial pre-loader animation displays a percentage and then reveals text characters in a circular, expanding motion before the main page content loads. No scroll-triggered motion is observed after the initial page load based on the provided sequence.
Content sections are clearly delineated by significant vertical whitespace and sometimes subtle background color shifts, with 'My Projects' and 'Experience' using a list-based, two-column layout.

technique_notes: An initial page load animation uses character-by-character reveal and circular path animation for text elements, creating a dynamic pre-loader experience. The main content then loads statically without further scroll-triggered animations.

The site employs a dark mode aesthetic with high contrast, using a very dark background and light text to make content pop. Large, sparse typography is used to create a sense of grandeur and focus on key information.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very oversized, thin, uppercase headings (~4-5x body text) with smaller, standard sans-serif body text for readability.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with predominantly rectangular elements and no noticeable rounded corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, especially in the hero and between major sections, creating a sense of spaciousness and focused content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a dramatic, almost theatrical dark aesthetic combined with extremely large, thin, uppercase typography for section titles creates a strong, minimalist, and high-impact visual identity. The circular pre-loader animation is also a unique and engaging touch.
